# Bibata-Modern-Ice (original)

Unmodified copy of the Bibata-Modern-Ice cursor theme, v2.0.6, in hyprcursor (`hyprcursors/`,
SVG) and XCursor (`cursors/`) form, as shipped by CachyOS in the `cachyos-hypr-noctalia`
package (`/etc/skel/.local/share/icons/Bibata-Modern-Ice`).

Bibata Cursor is made by Abdulkaiz Khatri (ful1e5): https://github.com/ful1e5/Bibata_Cursor —
licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0 (see ../LICENSE).

It is here so that `generate.py` builds the same Bibata-RGB on any system (it checks this
tree's name, version and checksum before building), and so that `install.sh` can install the
original when a system has none.
